subject: Marine Works - Canfisco Bay - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Canfisco Bay - Fraser River
Marine works for Sheet Pile Wall installation at Canfisco Bay in the vicinity of 49 07.458N 123 04.561W.

Hours of operation 1400UTC Nov 16 to 0200UTC Nov 19. 

FRPD Vessels on site montioring VHF Ch 16, 74, 71. 
Mariners requested to avoid the marine equipment staging area.
